title: Contents Packout & Storage — Carrier Money the Insured Passes On
content:
Carrier money is the insured's to pass on where the carrier does not pay the company. For the customer's share on an insurance-funded Contents Packout & Storage job of Partial Contents Packout or Full Contents Packout: **when the linked claim file is in denied or withdrawn status, the share carries every charge line on the job other than lines billed to customer, card surcharge lines and late fee lines, less the insurance postings on the job, never below zero; when the claim file is in any other status and contents-coverage carrier payments issued to the insured only are recorded on it, the share carries the lesser of two amounts, the first being those payments and the second being the approved contents scope less the carrier denied line write-offs on the contents coverage less the insurance postings on the job, never below zero; in every other case nothing is added.**

## Records read

- The status of the Insurance Claim Services claim file linked to the job.
- The contents-coverage carrier payments recorded on that file whose payee route is the insured only.
- The approved contents scope: the total of the carrier's contents-coverage scope approvals on the file.
- The carrier denied line write-offs on the file's contents coverage.
- The job's charge lines and the insurance postings on the job.

## Decision table

| Claim file status | Contents-coverage payments issued to the insured only | The share carries |
|---|---|---|
| denied or withdrawn | any | every charge line other than lines billed to customer, card surcharge lines and late fee lines, less insurance postings, never below zero |
| any other status | recorded | the lesser of (a) those payments and (b) approved contents scope less carrier denied line write-offs less insurance postings, never below zero |
| any other status | none recorded | nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical figures)

- Claim withdrawn; charge lines other than customer-billed, surcharge and late fee lines total 3,900.00; insurance postings 1,000.00: the share carries 2,900.00.
- Claim approved; 2,500.00 paid to the insured only; approved contents scope 4,000.00, denied line write-offs 300.00, postings 2,000.00: the second amount is 1,700.00, and the lesser of 2,500.00 and 1,700.00 is 1,700.00.
- Claim approved, nothing paid to the insured only: nothing.
